content: AUTOSAR RTE shall schedule SWC and BSW modules Type: Valid Description: The RTE shall support scheduling of executable entities (runnable entities) defined inside Software Components and the BSW Note: in case of Software Components the executable entities are called ‘runnables’, in case of the BSW ‘main function’. To shorten the description, the term ‘runnables’ is used for both Rationale: The runnable entities which need to be run based on certain events within the syst em need to be mapped to OS objects and started according to the application needs Use Case: Start all runnable entities which shall be scheduled in a certain period to one OS task and execute them in a defined order Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
